This is actually a reason some people
haven't
gone to MZ yet. An engine that is getting regular updates can break your game, especially with plugins. Once an engine is 'retired', you don't have to worry about things changing under the hood.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
TobyYasha said:
The only thing that's forcefully updated is the rpg maker editor itself.
Click to expand...
You can avoid Steam auto-updates by opting into a specific version via the Betas tab:
Steam Library -> RPG Maker MZ -> right-click -> Properties -> Betas -> (pick a version).
